audit_role: independent metric/source audit; no plot-generation or main-table code reused

metric_definition.AA_t: arithmetic mean(matrix[t][0:t+1]), zero-based t; includes current task
metric_definition.AAA_stage: arithmetic mean(stage_AA), each stage equal weight
metric_definition.upper_triangle_policy: unused future-task entries may be NaN; required lower triangle must be finite

selection_policy.ewc_best_selection_caveat: Maximum FAA over audited eligible archived runs; paired AAA from the same run. Retrospective test-score selection across configurations and seeds.

tolerances.note: Original table formatting retained, including half-rounding display differences such as InfLoRA Cars FAA 34.345 versus 34.34. EWC Cars uses ROUND_HALF_UP 34.555 -> 34.56.
